Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean walkable lunar terrain background, 1536x1024, SAME exact art direction and palette as approved reference.
Create the same polished detailed retro pixel-art lunar environment: lavender-grey dusty regolith, slate rocks, purple-grey mountain silhouettes, dark midnight starfield and blue Earth upper-right. Horizon at 22% height.
CRITICAL WALKABLE COMPOSITION: the entire region x=14% through 85%, y=48% through 96% MUST be broad continuous FLAT OPEN DUSTY PLAIN, with only fine mottled regolith texture, tiny pebble flecks and very low shallow dust undulations. There are NO large rocks, NO ridges, NO crater holes, NO cliffs, NO elevation changes in that central foreground. Two astronauts will walk across this plane, a console will be placed at x=22% y=72%, a habitat at x=50% y=60%. Leave all those locations clean. Detailed boulders confined strictly to x<10% and x>91% at sides. Craters may exist only far in the distance, above 42% image height. DO NOT draw any astronauts, building, console, vehicles, roads, footprints, props, text, titles or UI.
Style matching is paramount: rich soft pixel-shaded detail, clustered square pixels, beautiful cool lunar palette exactly like reference, navy shadows and atmospheric stars. This is a new background, reference unchanged.
note: Accepted after local browser inspection. Initial terrain rejected because foreground rocks crossed walking circuit. Approved Library reference unchanged.
